details.description: Llama 3.1 405B Instruct is the largest model in Meta's Llama 3.1 family, a dense auto-regressive transformer using grouped-query attention, instruction-tuned with supervised fine-tuning and RLHF for multilingual dialogue and released July 23, 2024. It was trained on roughly 15 trillion tokens of publicly available data with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023. Meta describes it as competitive with leading closed models such as GPT-4, GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet across more than 150 benchmark datasets, and it supports tool use for agentic workloads across eight languages.
advantages: Scores 87.3 on MMLU (5-shot), per Meta's Llama 3.1 405B Instruct model card.
Scores 89.0 pass@1 on HumanEval and 96.8% on GSM-8K with chain-of-thought prompting, per Meta's Llama 3.1 405B Instruct model card.
Scores 96.9 on ARC-Challenge and 88.6 on IFEval, an instruction-following benchmark, per Meta's Llama 3.1 405B Instruct model card.
Meta reports the model is competitive with GPT-4, GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet across 150+ benchmark datasets, per Meta's Llama 3.1 launch post.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's Llama 3.1 405B Instruct model card.
use_cases: Multilingual conversational agents across eight supported languages
Synthetic data generation and model distillation for smaller models

sources.title: Introducing Llama 3.1: Our most capable models to date

notes: Catalog facts list max_input_tokens and max_output_tokens as 32,768 for this Hyperbolic-served deployment; Meta's own Hugging Face model card and launch blog state the model natively supports a 128K-token context window.
